name: `shoptet build` command
description:
Production build command: minification, correct output filenames (fixes the documented mismatch — markup.header.min.html vs the actually-produced markups.header.html), and every scaffolded entry actually gets bundled (fixes the legacy bug where src/orderFinale was silently never bundled because webpack hardcoded ['footer','header','index']).

Output must be deployable via the existing legacy SFTP/GitHub-App path unchanged.

Reference: cli-greenfield.md §2.6, §10.
